title: fix(kanban): a list view board laned by a lookup shows each lane's whole sum, avg, min and max, not one page's
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW
Fixes #36871
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:列表里的看板,泳道按查找字段决定时,泳道底部的合计、平均、最小、最大值现在按整条泳道的全部记录计算,不再只加当前这一页;平均、最小、最大也不再空白。
- 为什么做:看板泳道统计这一族的收尾(上一张卡已让看板自己查询时按整条泳道计算),这里补上列表把一页数据交给看板的那条路径。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是泳道底部不显示统计数字,不会显示错误的数字;卡片、泳道和计数不受影响,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

Route **(A)**, the preferred one: on ListView's rows-handed kanban path the board now queries its lane figures over the whole lane, through the same `queryGroupHeaders` + `readLaneStatistic` read a self-querying board uses (a cut answer, a refused read or a source without the door draws no figure). That fixes `sum`, `avg`, `min` and `max` at once, so no "loaded only" marker and no new locale string is needed, and the view-settings picker stays as it is.

- `@object-ui/plugin-list` (`ListView.tsx`): new `kanbanLaneStatisticHosted` = kanban view, not lane-paged, and this list fetches for itself (not inline rows, not a `value` provider). For that board the node's `filter` is the effective filter the list's own window was fetched with (`selfQueryFilter`, the same value the lane-paged board gets), and a new host prop `laneStatisticQuery` carries the toolbar search term and fields and a reload key built from `refreshKey`, `refreshTrigger` and the invalidation nonce.
- `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: `ObjectKanban` takes `laneStatisticQuery` (type `KanbanLaneStatisticRequest`, in `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`). With handed cards and that prop, `laneReadAsked` is true and the board asks the lane read under the node filter and the host's search pair, and asks again when the reload key moves. Without the prop nothing changes: cards handed in whole still get a `sum` added up over them, and no other figure.
- Docblocks updated: `LaneFootStatistic` (`KanbanImpl.tsx`), `KanbanColumnSummary.figures`, the `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts` module header.
- `@objectstack/spec`: the `KanbanConfig.summary` describe (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) and the `KanbanLaneSummarySchema` docblock drop the "known gap" sentence and say what that board draws. The generated mirror `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` carries the same text (`check:generated` and `check:docs` green). The describe lives in `@objectstack/spec`, not `@object-ui/types` as the claim's file surface put it: same text, different package.
- `.changeset/36871-kanban-rows-handed-lane-statistic.md`: new (patch: plugin-kanban, plugin-list, spec). One sentence in it supersedes the "known gap" line of #36857's still-pending note (`.changeset/36520-kanban-lane-statistic-server.md`, left byte-identical to `main`) for the lookup-lane list view board.

### What widens (Clause-② yes)

- `ObjectKanbanComponentProps`, exported by `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, gains the optional `laneStatisticQuery?: KanbanLaneStatisticRequest`. `KanbanLaneStatisticRequest` itself is not exported from the package index. No other exported member changed: the spec edit is describe text only, and ListView's exported props are unchanged.

Overlap: `overlap-check` (no exclusions) is clean at head 790a94319c, and `origin/main` merges cleanly.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins added (3 files) and the ablation</summary>

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`: new top-level describe. The real board runs under the real ListView with a lookup lane field (`account` references `crm_account`, no options), 60 deals alternating over two accounts, and `pagination.pageSize: 25`. A rig self-check asserts 25 cards (13 / 12) are drawn. Then `sum`, `avg`, `min` and `max` read 870/900, 29/30, 0/1 and 58/59: the whole lanes, never the page's 156/144 or 24/23. The read runs under the view's filter (850/875). CONTROL: a source with no grouped door draws no figure, never the page's sum.
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx`: a board handed 3 cards plus `laneStatisticQuery` draws the whole lane's `sum`, `avg`, `min` and `max` (2415 / 34.5 / 0 / 69) and calls no `find`. The read carries the node filter and the host's search pair, and it is asked again when `reloadKey` moves. The existing "adds the cards a host hands in" test is the control for cards handed in without their query.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.kanbanOwnsLanes-12619.test.tsx`: the rows-handed board gets `data`, `laneStatisticQuery` and, as `filter`, exactly the `$filter` of the list's own query. The swimlane board gets the request too. CONTROLS: the lane-paged board does not get it, and neither does a board over `value`-provider rows.
- Ablation, committed first and then run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `ObjectKanban.tsx`: `const laneReadAsked = boardQueriesItself || hostHandsQuery;` became `... || (hostHandsQuery && false);`. Anchor count went 1 to 0, blob `908a872bc29b` to `396418ba8a82`. Result: **11 failed / 25 passed**. That is every new 36871 pin in both suites, the no-door CONTROL included, because the page's sum came back. The red is the defect itself: `expected '156' to be '870'`, `expected '286' to be '850'`, `expected '3' to be '2415'`. Restored: blob after restore equals HEAD (`908a872bc29b`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and type-checks (head da9a59cb5a; 790a94319c changes only changeset text)</summary>

- `vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/plugin-list/` (ui root config): Test Files 274 passed, Tests 2650 passed.
- The three touched test files alone: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 49 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban run type-check` and `... plugin-list run type-check`: exit 0, both. Each covers `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check: not run locally, left to CI (`Type Check UI`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Swimlane board (a view with grouping).** The swimlane layout draws no lane foot at all: `LaneFootStatistic` is rendered only in `KanbanColumnView`, the flat layout. So the card's "grouped view" face does not exist as a page-scoped sum. The board still offers every statistic in the picker and then draws none. That is reported, not fixed here.
- **Other faces of the same path, left alone.** On the rows-handed board the lane header count and the foot `count` still count the page, with no `+`. A lane whose records all fall past the first page is not drawn. A `summarizeField` header total still sums the page. The list footer's window warning is the only marker of the window. All of these are reported, not fixed here.
- Cards handed in whole without a query (inline rows, or a host that is not ListView) still draw `sum` only. That is correct for `sum`, and `avg`/`min`/`max` stay blank there, as before.

## Verification

- Read first: `ObjectKanban.tsx` at `hostQuery` / `hostHandsQuery` / `laneReadAsked` (the gate), `ListView.tsx` at `kanbanLaneStatisticHosted` and the `laneStatisticQuery` spread, then the app-shell describe.
- Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`. Expect 9 passed, and the 36871 describe shows `sum covers every record of each lane over a window of one page`.
